env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false
env CGO_ENABLED=0

cd m

# Deleted invalid sources must stay absent. Inactive replacements and inserted
# sources must be selected from their effective contents in every helper.
logos build -overlay=overlay.json --emit-go=out .
exists out/main.go
exists out/variant.go
exists out/inserted.go
! exists out/removed.go
! exists out/ignored.go
! exists out/.overlay/variant.go
! exists out/.overlay/inserted.go
! exists out/.overlay/ignored.go
! grep 'physicalOnly|missing' out/variant.go
grep 'Variant' out/variant.go
grep 'Inserted' out/inserted.go

cd out
go run -tags=overlay_extra .
stderr '^overlay ok$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/overlay

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

func main() { println("overlay ok") }

-- m/removed.lgo --
package main

func Broken() { missing() }

-- m/variant.lgo --
//go:build physicalOnly

package main

func BrokenVariant() { missing() }

-- m/ignored.lgo --
//go:build physicalOnly

package main

func BrokenIgnored() { missing() }

-- m/overlay.json --
{
	"Replace": {
		"removed.lgo": "",
		"variant.lgo": ".overlay/variant.lgo",
		"ignored.lgo": ".overlay/ignored.lgo",
		"inserted.lgo": ".overlay/inserted.lgo"
	}
}

-- m/.overlay/variant.lgo --
//go:build overlay_extra

package main

func Variant() int {
	var value int? = 42
	return value ?? 0
}

-- m/.overlay/inserted.lgo --
//go:build overlay_extra

package main

func Inserted() int {
	var value int? = 7
	return value ?? 0
}

-- m/.overlay/ignored.lgo --
//go:build ignore

package main

func Ignored() { missing() }
